paper_inconsistencies: Tables 3-4 (p. 6) are consistent with integer cells (e.g. 2/62/8/70 of 142 and 42/6/54/48 of 150); the cell n are not printed, so only the 'Proportion of total' column is used as targets
Table 5 / 7 RT cells and the ANOVAs are not replayable (no timings); not used
meta.omitted_decision: The paper describes no instruction or title page (contrast LESSONS 494, where an instruction page is described and its text missing); its only screen statements are '(6a) and (6b) were displayed in two separate screens' (p. 5), 'displayed separately in two steps' (p. 8) and Appendix A's advance lines (p. 12), all modelled as stages. Consent appears only as 'All subjects gave written informed consent' (pp. 5, 8): it is HIT / booklet context, not task content, and is listed in `omitted` as missing with the button labels and the debrief; no stage is served for it. Nothing converter-written is served (README Decided 16(d)). Same treatment as hall2024gettier, aiyer2023outcomebias. Searched: paper, Appendix A, Frontiers page, Crossref; the Europe PMC page returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Alternative: block both arms until a consent / instruction text is known

s1.text: Imagine you gave a speech at a small political meeting. You are discussing your speech with Denise, who was also there. There were 6 other people in the audience that day. You tell Denise that you are thinking about giving the same speech to another group.

s2.text: Imagine you gave a speech at a small political meeting. You are discussing your speech with Denise, who was also there. There were 6 other people in the audience that day and you know that Denise spoke with all of them about it later. You tell Denise that you would like to know the audience’s reaction.
